note: Scripts of closed obfuscators that were read for this project. None is stored in the repository (its authors did not license it, or it is a third party's output): they sit in quicksilver/local/ (git-ignored). tools/formats/measure.mjs re-measures every one that is present and checks its SHA-256; records for the others keep their last measured numbers and say so.

samples.source: https://github.com/Nonition/MoonveilDeobfuscator (research/rideafish), the reference is that repository's hand-made reconstruction
